Hi Emily — quick technical checklist ahead of the QBR:

- Network & access: provide FQDNs/IP ranges for allowlist; if you want private peering we’ll need the VPC/subnet range and an owner + contact for peering setup.
- Models & sizes: which model families will hit peak traffic (gpt-4x / gpt-2-medium custom) and expected avg sequence length. That drives the KV cache sizing.
- Throughput expectation: you noted a 35% buffer — can you confirm baseline RPS and expected peak RPS during surge windows? Example: baseline 120 RPS, peak 360 RPS for 10–12 minute bursts.
- Migration window: recommend a 2-hour maintenance window for the initial capacity soak (off-peak).

I’ll prepare a short runbook and a one-page chart showing latency at target QPS for the QBR. If you can drop the throughput numbers into the questionnaire Rajiv was circulated, I’ll incorporate them immediately.

Cheers,
Karthik
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
